g.text: IT power of the world's largest AI data centers, 2023–2030

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: What it shows: IT power across the 77 AI data centers Epoch tracks, stacked by owner. Solid ground is observed to

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 2026-08-06; the shaded band is Epoch's projection from announced construction schedules.

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — https://epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Methodology: Epoch AI data centers documentation — site-level cumulative snapshots, step-summed across sites

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: Snapshot downloaded 2026-08-06; Epoch updates the dataset in place, so live figures will differ. Reading 11.4 GW at the snapshot and

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 34.0 GW by 2030 on present plans. IT power is the load of the computing equipment itself, not the facility total, and is largely

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: inferred from cooling equipment visible in satellite imagery. Coverage is about 27% of AI compute delivered globally and is strongest

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: for the largest sites, so this is a floor on the total, not the whole market. Everything right of the dashed line is a schedule, not

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: a measurement, and announced build-outs slip. The flattening after 2029 is an artefact of the data ending, not a forecast of

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: saturation: each site is held at its last announced milestone, and few sites have published one beyond then.
